node_definition.done_when: Tests with a temporary crew home run an admission pass over a queue of requests and kill it with SIGKILL at each stage of the pass: before any release, after a release and before the launch, during the launch, and after the worker starts and before its pointer is written. After each kill a fresh pass runs, and the test reads the set of request ids, each in a phase from the deliverable's list, equal to the set before the kill, with no request launched twice. A further test restarts the station partway through a tick and reads the queued count its first published tick reports equal to the count of queued requests in the store; on 15 November the lead saw the published queue fall from 31 to 14 in one tick and return to 31, beside station restarts at 10:16, 10:19 and 10:34 UTC. Negative control: at the base revision at least one stage leaves a request absent, stranded or launched twice; the failing stage and run are logged to  docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/s73.html . The tests run on  all_debug .
node_definition.goal: make an admit-service kill at any stage of a pass lose no request and keep the published queue count
